Invoices for German customers crash since the shop passes the country code as
it stores it ("DE"). The invoice in question has two copies of BK-1001 (a
book: 7% VAT in Germany) at 10.00 each with a 2.00 discount on the line, so
its gross total should be 19.26 (18.00 plus 1.26 VAT).

    invoice_total([parse_line("2 x BK-1001 @ 10.00 - 2.00")], "DE")
